text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — FinCoX POC. They asked for a single acceptance matrix covering latency, cost, and quality. Can we align on numbers & who owns what by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tasha_solutions: I can drive the customer prompts/evals. Need confirmation on the eval set size and the latency buckets we commit to.

ben_infra: For Dedicated vs Hosted routing, we should call out both. Hosted target is easier to promise with fallbacks. Roughly: p95 latency targets, and sustained throughput targets.

maya_ml: For quality we'll run ~200 labeled prompts across the core use cases (extraction, summarization, classification). Pass = >= 92% top-1 accuracy on the classification set; ROUGE-L >= 0.60 for summaries. Is that acceptable?

alex_sales: Customer asks for thresholds, not just metrics. Example: "accept if p95 < 250ms for 256-token responses AND quality thresholds met". Also they want cost estimate line-item for expected 10M tokens/month.

luke_product: Agree on p95 for latency. Suggest we provide two profiles: "Low-latency (p95 <= 200ms, up to 1k qps bursts)" and "Cost-optimized (p95 <= 500ms, aggressive batching, quantized model)". Call out fallback to cheaper model if Dedicated capacity saturated.

karen_security: They also pushed a security questionnaire and need timeline for SOC2 controls evidence and KMS integration. We should commit to answering questionnaire within 3 business days for initial pass, and provide customer-facing architecture diagram.

sam_engops: Ops notes: to hit p95 200ms we need warm KV cache and continuous batching tuned. For the POC duration (4 weeks), we can provision a dedicated pool with pre-warmed replicas. Estimated infra delta: +2 GPUs for the first 2 weeks to cover ramp.

alex_sales: Pricing ask: they want committed monthly and burst pricing. Can we model two scenarios: 10M tokens/mo baseline + 30% burst and a pay-as-you-go with soft commit?

ben_infra: Yes. Quick back-of-envelope: hosted gen cost ~ $X per 1k tokens (placeholder), dedicated amortized lowers unit cost by ~30%. I'll prepare a comparison table. Need to confirm exact model variant (e.g., small vs medium quantized).

maya_ml: Eval plan (high level):
```
- 200 prompts split: 80 extraction, 60 summarization, 60 classification
- 3 model variants: baseline (fp16), quantized-8, fallback-small
- Metrics: accuracy, ROUGE-L, p95 latency, median latency, token cost per 1k
- Acceptance: quality thresholds + latency profile + no critical security findings
```

alex_sales: Customer also requested an "abort criteria" clause: if hallucination rate > 8% on extraction after 2 weeks, they want to stop. Add that?

maya_ml: Add hallucination metric: measured via human labels on a 50-sample rolling window. Abort if >8% after week 2 post-tuning.

luke_product: Operational acceptance: we need canary routing and automatic fallback policy documented. I'll draft the rollout plan: canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 24h with automatic rollback on error rate >2% or latency regression >20%.

karen_security: For the security questionnaire: I can own initial answers. Please send the doc. I'll need network diagrams, data retention policies, KMS key rotation policy, and an expected date to hand off logs for audit.

alex_sales: I'll share the questionnaire now: https://files.internal/fincox/sq-2026-03.docx and we'll target the 3 business day turnaround.

sam_engops: One more ops note: include a perf test run and the exact CLI commands we'll run. Example command for perf harness:
```
./perf-run --model quant8 --seq 512 --qps 200 --duration 1800 --warmup 300
```
Outputs: p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, GPU util.

ben_infra: I'll attach cost calc and two model config options by noon.

tasha_solutions: I'll assemble the eval prompt set and sample scoring rubric. Need a volunteer for manual labeling of 50 samples/week — can someone from SE help? @sam_engops?

sam_engops: I can do the first week labeling and help automate the labeling pipeline.

alex_sales: Great. Action items:
- karen_security: initial security answers & diagrams (3 business days)
- ben_infra: cost comparison + infra plan (EOD)
- maya_ml & tasha_solutions: eval set + acceptance tests (48h)
- luke_product: rollout/canary doc (48h)
- sam_engops: perf command & initial labeling (this week)

alex_sales: If we all hit these it'll let us present a single POC acceptance matrix to FinCoX on Friday. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
